ModMetaData.name: Overlord: Tier Magic (for Isekai RPG Leveling)
ModMetaData.author: Zeharyus
ModMetaData.description:
Overlord: Tier Magic is a magic overhaul for Isekai RPG Leveling, made by Zeharyus. Three classes of power, all built on your pawns' Isekai level, rank and stats. Nothing here works without Isekai: it reads the level, rank, INT and WIS Isekai already gives your pawns.
REQUIRED - Harmony - Isekai RPG Leveling (JellyCreative.IsekaiLeveling) Load order: Harmony, then Isekai RPG Leveling, then this mod. RimWorld 1.6 and 1.7.
HOW TO START Select a colonist, press the Grimoire button, pick a path and learn spells. Tick the spells you want "Prepared" and they appear as ability buttons on the command bar. Dev mode adds a "Dev: Overlord" button for testing.
TIER MAGIC - 158 spells, 0th to 10th tier plus Super-Tier. Examples: Magic Arrow (1st), Fireball and Lightning (3rd), Summon Undead (1st, 3rd and 4th), Raise Dead (5th), Grasp Heart (9th), Time Stop and Reality Slash (10th), Fallen Down (Super-Tier). - Three caster paths. Arcane runs on INT; Divine and Spiritual run on WIS. The path decides which spells a pawn can learn. - Tiers unlock with Isekai level: tier 0 at level 1, tier 1 at 3, tier 2 at 8, then 15, 26, 40, 60, 90, 130, 200, and tier 10 at 300. Super-Tier unlocks at level 401, SSS rank, which Isekai already titles "Overlord". - Learn 3 spells per level (max 300), then prepare a working set. You get 8 prepared slots plus 1 per 20 WIS, up to 30. - Mana: 10 + level + 4 x main stat + 2 x the other. It regenerates from WIS, twice as fast asleep. - Metamagic toggles on the caster: Maximize, Widen, Triplet, Extend, Penetrate and Boost. Each makes a spell stronger and costs more mana. They never apply to Super-Tier. - Rank matters. Instant-death spells fail against equal or higher rank (one rank lower: 50% chance, two lower: 80%, three or more: certain). Mind spells land 50% at equal rank, +25% per rank of difference. - Casting a spell gives Isekai XP. Energy Drain really takes Isekai levels away, and Raise Dead costs the revived pawn about 5% of theirs. - Summons and raised dead fade when the spell ends. Only one army at a time, and they never cause "colonist died" grief. - Time Stop freezes the whole map for 12 seconds except the caster. Damage taken in that time lands when time resumes. - Hold Shift to aim a harmful spell at an ally, as with vanilla attacks. - Every spell has its own visuals: casting circles, projectiles with trails, blasts, real lightning, and aiming previews that show who will resist. They can be switched off, or the camera shake turned down, in Options > Mod settings > Overlord Tier Magic: visual effects.
THE GEASS (Lelouch-style class, one per colony) Open a colonist's Grimoire with no path and choose The Geass. Make a contract with C.C., then command people with a glance. The target must see you, be awake and have their eyes uncovered. Every person can be Geassed only once, whether the order worked or was resisted. - Contract: Don't move (frozen), Give me (drops their weapon), Answer me (a raid on your home is announced 12 hours ahead), Forget (one person you pick), Die (needs a gap of 3 ranks or more, otherwise a short stun). - Stage 2: Fight (berserk), Live! (the next death doesn't happen), Reset (burns all MP and a soul bottle so everyone can be ordered again). - The second eye: Obey me (a target two ranks lower joins you as a follower), Mass command (one order for every enemy looking at you), Move the pieces (orders for your followers). - It grows with use. When it overflows, chatting with colonists can turn into accidental commands until you put the lens back in. There is an optional ending where C.C. asks you to take her Code. - Plus: Chess (a warning letter before each raid), the Black King's mask, According to plan (trap cell), and Geass Cancellers carried by some hostile humans.
THE ALMIGHTY (future-sight class, one per colony) Choose it from the Grimoire on a colonist with no path. An eye bar tracks foresight charges. - Foresee and dodge blows, rewrite futures (Look Back and Look Ahead), and copy abilities that would have hit you. - Heilig Pfeil, Blut Vene and Blut Arterie, Schatten (step through a shadow and come out beside anyone holding one of your Schrift letters, even in a caravan), Gift of Power (hand out Schrift letters), Auswählen, Future Erasure, Burner Finger, Galvano Blast, Freund Schild, Iron Skin, Jail, Fear, Weak Point and Miracle. - Isekai rank decides how far each one reaches. Death while The Almighty is open can leave a pool of foresight that brings the pawn back.
ENEMY CASTERS Hostile humans of rank C or higher can get a path, mana and a spell build of their own. They cast attacks and support only, and choose their own targets. Animals, insects and mechs are not included.
SOULS AND GUARDIANS A worthy colonist who dies can have their soul caught within half a day, sealed in a bottle and bound to a guardian statue. The statue then builds a see-through, mana-blue spirit body at half their level, with their name, traits, skills, spells and gear. You need research on the Overlord tab (soul scooping, engineering, transformation, invigoration), power, and soul batteries filled by your casters. Spirit guardians don't eat, sleep or age. A worthy-soul guardian can be revived into their own body at full level.
COMPATIBILITY Load after: Harmony, Isekai RPG Leveling. Safe to add to an existing save. Spells, buildings and effects use their own defs, all named OM_..., so they do not replace vanilla or other mods' defs. Optional support, only active when the other mod is loaded: - Facial Animation (Nals): the Geass user gets real violet Facial Animation eyes and the spirit guardians get see-through heads with solid eyes, lids, brows and mouth. The eye animation adapts to the lid height; lids from the Experimentals and Retexture add-ons are covered by a built-in table but have not all been tested. - Layered Apparel (costel): spirit guardians keep the person's layered cosmetics. - Dubs Bad Hygiene: spirit guardians are exempt from hygiene, bladder and thirst. - Vanilla Social Interactions Expanded: its chats, venting and teaching can trigger the Geass runaway accidents, each with its own weights. Other mods' social interactions also work with default weights. Modded helmets that wrongly hide or show the eyes can be fixed with a small XML patch (see the GitHub page). Not tested with other magic or class mods. If you find a conflict, please report it with your log.
Made by Zeharyus. Fan-made and not affiliated with the creators or rights holders of Overlord, Code Geass or Bleach.
Requires Harmony and Isekai RPG Leveling.
